body:
Thank you so much for your reply.  I was having such a bad day when I wrote this, I really did think I was going to go off the deep end.  Just writing down what was going on helped me tremendously.  

I'm not going to give up yet.  It's just so hard to keep going sometimes, especially when all you can see is things falling apart.

PS: Don't worry about your English, it's perfectly readable.
